summary: ESPN's usable soccer athlete surface is search/v2 for resolution plus .../athletes/<id>/overview for season stats, per-competition splits, and recent-match form; the common/v3/search endpoint is dead and a regen must not reintroduce it.
reason: common/v3/search silently returns count:0 for every query (verified across multiple global players), so the generated ESPN lookup produced a 100% 'no ESPN athlete result' miss. Resolution now guards on soccer+name-match to avoid resolving the wrong athlete once the sport filter is gone, and a doctor canary flags the next silent endpoint death.
validated_outcome: player 'joao neves' returns sources.espn ok with athleteId 355061, non-empty season stats and per-competition splits (Portugal teamId 482), and recent games; team reports enrich ESPN for the top players by market value within a budget; doctor's ESPN Source canary reports healthy.
